deficits.suggestion: Create a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian route parallel to the road.
Create a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian route parallel to the road.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at both sides of the marked crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids.
Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: Footways are clearly visible on both sides of the road in all frames.
A wide footway is clearly visible on the right side of the road.
The road is not wide enough to necessitate a pedestrian refuge island.
Kerb ramps are visible at the crossing in the first and second frames.
Street lighting poles are visible along the street.
